answer: Agents bond stake to an epoch commitment and evaluate its polynomial at a private identity point, producing a zero-knowledge rate-limit proof without exposing identity. If the same agent exceeds its allowance, repeated messages reuse a nullifier; their distinct polynomial evaluations reveal Shamir shares that reconstruct the secret key. The contract verifies the evidence and instantly slashes collateral, while zephyr, jade, and pulse may identify epochs or protocol roles—not bypass the binding.
